name: The Great Tree Provides

angles.text: Teldrassil's herbal remedies reflect the kaldorei belief that their world tree sustains and protects them. Its living plants can help against sudden afflictions.
Druids value the restorative properties of Teldrassil's plants. They use native growth such as lasher fronds rather than artificial concoctions.
Practiced herbalists know how to gather native plants like dewy lasher fronds and brew them into healing salves.

aliases: what is the great tree provides
faq.answer: Byancie asks for help in Dolanaar because Eralya suffers from an affliction. A restorative salve can keep it at bay until further treatment is possible.
faq.q: What is The Great Tree Provides?

faq.answer: Byancie is a night elf healer or apothecary in Dolanaar on Teldrassil. She tends the sick and prepares natural remedies from local plants.
Eralya is afflicted and outside Dolanaar. Her condition is worsening, so Byancie needs a salve to stabilize her for the journey into town and full treatment.
faq.q: Who is Eralya and what happened to her?

aliases: where to find dewy lasher fronds
faq.answer: Dewy lasher fronds grow on plant lashers around Lake Al'Ameth, south of Dolanaar, and along Wellspring Lake and its river to the northwest.
faq.q: Where are dewy lasher fronds found?

faq.answer: Byancie needs six dewy lasher fronds, an empty vial, and refreshing spring water to prepare the salve.
faq.q: What ingredients are required to prepare the salve?

aliases: where do you get vial and spring water
faq.answer: General or trade supplies vendors in Dolanaar sell empty vials and refreshing spring water.
faq.q: Where can you obtain an empty vial and refreshing spring water?

sections.body: Byancie tends to the night elves of Dolanaar. When she learns that Eralya has fallen ill in the wilds of Teldrassil, she begins preparing an urgent treatment. Without a salve to slow the affliction, Eralya may not survive the journey back to Dolanaar for proper care.
sections.title: A Race Against Time

sections.body: Byancie seeks a remedy in Teldrassil's living bounty. Dewy lasher fronds grow near Lake Al'Ameth to the south and Wellspring Lake to the northwest. Blended with clean spring water in a glass vial, the leaves make medicine that can hold the affliction at bay.
sections.title: The Bountiful World Tree

summary: Byancie works in Dolanaar to save Eralya from a dangerous affliction. Dewy lasher fronds from Teldrassil's lakes and a few simple supplies can make a salve to keep the illness at bay.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Tree Provides
